verdict.rationale: Live, always-available customer support is a fair question for a business banking and spend platform like Brex, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of 24/7 or live support channels. Community posts about account closures and offboarding concern service termination, not support availability, so they neither establish nor contradict this capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can reach live customer support at any time for urgent account issues
